product_metadata.title: Sobakawa Cloud Pillow with Microbead Fill- Microbead Pillow- Contoured-Shaped Pillow for Neck and Head- Support Pillow for Sounder Sleep- Microbead Pillow for Sleeping- White
features: CAREFULLY DESIGNED CLOUD PILLOW: The ergonomic design of our micro-air bead pillow is carefully designed to help promote sound sleep. The unique breathable design of our pillow is naturally unlike a traditional pillow. Lay your head on our cloud pillow and accommodate a proper sleeping position.

MICRO-AIR BEAD TECHNOLOGY: Our cloud pillow uses over 10 million micro-air beads to provide contoured support, cooling comfort airflow, as well as head and neck support. This pillow is made from 87% polyester and 13% spandex, features a standard pillow size and includes a custom fit cover.

SUPPORT PILLOW: Our cloud pillow features a contoured-shaped design to provide head, shoulder, and neck support. The unique design and shape of our pillow for sleeping conform to individual anatomy and can adjust to your head, shoulders, back, and neck to help achieve good sleep.

VERSATILE BEAD PILLOW: Sobakawa Pillow can be used for various purposes. One use of our pillow is for any sleeping position. Our pillow is also ideal for lower back support while driving. Enjoy watching TV and doing yoga with our multipurpose pillow.

ABOUT US: Top Dog Direct is a team of champions designed to execute all the functions required to quickly bring products to market, instead of a large bureaucracy. Top Dog Direct is run by Bill McAlister, who finds new products and takes TV successes to retail, with over a billion in retail sales. "As Seen on TV" products are his specialty.
